notes.title: Update - gameplay improvements
notes.notes:
Added French localization.
Now you can zoom and examine inventory items.
Level 6 puzzle improvements.
Controls improvements.
Fixed misclicks and wrong camera movement.
Added sound and music volume sliders.
Added fast forward and pause in hint screen.
Added level numbers.
Faster camera movement .
Added option to restart level on select.
Small bugfixes.
Option to flip X/Y camera axis .
Added detailed textures.
Added exit confirmation.
